original.question: Jerry o'ltti qirrali zar tashlamoqda. Uning 3 dan katta son tashlashi, ikkita juft sonni ketma-ket tashlashidan (foiz nuqtalari bilan ifodalangan) qanchalik ehtimolroq?
original.answer:
Zarda 3 ta 3 dan katta son bor, shuning uchun ulardan birini tashlash ehtimoli 3/6=50%.
Bitta juft son tashlash ehtimoli 50%, shuning uchun ketma-ket ikkitasini tashlash ehtimoli 50% * 50% = 25%.
Ushbu ikki ehtimollik orasidagi farq 50% - 25% = 25%.
